item.title: September 09, 2026 - Feet of clay
item.description: Page 263. "One of the biggest stumbling blocks to recovery seems to be placing unrealistic expectations on... others." Just for Today: My friends and my sponsor are human, just like me--and I trust their experience all the more for that.
